Before the next run

A few things
worth knowing.

Do I need a key to play?

No. Downloading NovaClient lets you open and play. Connected services and optional account cosmetics have their own requirements.

Does this change server physics or reduce ping?

No. Prediction and visual settings affect the client experience, not server rules or network round-trip time. Results depend on your setup and connection.

What is local practice?

A separate local practice environment. It does not complete an official server run for you or alter the official server world.

Which systems are supported?

Windows x64 and Linux x86_64. The Linux package uses an Ubuntu 24.04 / glibc 2.39 baseline. Check the release notes for runtime requirements.
